target_customer: DevOps and security teams at small and mid-sized software companies running on AWS, Azure and GCP
problem: Teams struggle to keep multi-account cloud infrastructure secure and compliant without a large security staff.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription, sold also through AWS Marketplace
product_category: Cloud security posture management, later CNAPP

founders.name: Sujay Maheshwari
founders.background_notes: YC bio: product and technology, making cloud secure account by account.

competitors.name: Prowler
competitors.what: Open-source AWS security and compliance scanner

technical_complexity.rationale: Needs read-only integrations across several clouds, rule engines and compliance mapping; standard engineering with many integrations.

defensibility.rationale: Many open-source and funded vendors offered posture scanning, so features were copyable.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Well-funded rivals kept growing; Cloudanix remains independent per its site.

market_need_then: Cloud misconfiguration and compliance were widely discussed needs, but no dated Cloudanix-specific evidence was found.

brand_strength.rationale: Search found no brand coverage and the name is easily confused with CloudNatix in funding searches.

outcome_analysis: Cloudanix is active with offices in Sunnyvale and Pune and claims 100+ customers, SOC 2 and ISO 27001. Funding is not publicly confirmed beyond YC backing, and it competes with far larger vendors, so its trajectory looks capital light rather than clearly strong or weak.
notes: Rounds added in the completeness pass rest on single databases: Seedtable (2021-09 seed, 125K reported in search summary; CB Insights dates a seed 2021-08-30, likely the same round) and CB Insights (2023 pre-seed and accelerator rounds, no amounts). CB Insights total is 130K over four rounds, which does not match 125K plus the unlabeled 2023 rounds; amounts not summed. Not CloudNatix, which raised a 4.5M seed in 2021-01 and is a different company. Press found no round for Cloudanix.
